verdict.rationale: Epic's docs confirm Blueprints let designers use most programmer-level tools without code (unreal-docs-1), and this is Unreal's flagship visual-scripting system for gameplay logic. However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict full no-code sufficiency: one dev states Blueprints were 'not sufficient' for adding content like vehicles and required C++ (unreal-comm-4), and another notes complex Blueprint graphs 'cascade inefficiencies' making C++ necessary at scale (unreal-comm-15), with a third citing C++ as the main pain point when trying to avoid it (unreal-comm-7). Missing for 10: independent case studies of large shipped games built purely in Blueprints without C++ fallback, and clearer scoping of what gameplay complexity Blueprints alone can handle.
